Our engineering roots

Our roots
in Pune.

Raj Defence and Aerospace grew out of Raj Process Equipments and Systems in Pune. The group’s experience in industrial gas plants now informs its work on hydrogen-powered aircraft.

Today, the Pune team brings that industrial experience to the design and assembly of unmanned systems.
